description: This SQL script configures Row Level Security (RLS) policies and functions for a PostgreSQL database, specifically for a Supabase setup managing user data, organizations, projects, tasks, comments, attachments, and GitHub repositories. It primarily enables RLS, drops existing policies, and creates new access policies based on user membership and roles.

methods.name: public.get_current_user_id
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the current user based on JWT claims or session GUC, enabling user-specific RLS policies.

calls: select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename='...'
